@default(now())\n\n  @@unique([organizationId, assertionId])\n  @@index([expiresAt])\n}\n\nmodel PasswordResetToken {\n  id        String    @id @default(cuid())\n  userId    String\n  tokenHash String    @unique\n  expiresAt DateTime\n  usedAt    DateTime?\n  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())\n  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel MfaRecoveryCode {\n  id        String    @id @default(cuid())\n  userId    String\n  codeHash  String\n  usedAt    DateTime?\n  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())\n  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([userId, codeHash])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel EnterpriseOrganizationSettings {\n  organizationId         String       @id\n  ipAllowlist            String[]\n  sessionDurationMinutes Int          @default(43200)\n  requireMfaForAdmins    Boolean      @default(true)\n  dataRetentionDays      Int          @default(365)\n  legalHoldEnabled       Boolean      @default(false)\n  ssoEnforced            Boolean      @default(false)\n  ssoEnforcedAt          DateTime?\n  updatedAt              DateTime     @updatedAt\n  organization           Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n}\n\nmodel VerifiedDomain {\n  id                String       @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId    String\n  domain            String\n  verificationToken String\n  verifiedAt        DateTime?\n  redirectWww       Boolean      @default(true)\n  wildcardEnabled   Boolean      @default(false)\n  sslStatus         String       @default(\"pending_dns\")\n  createdAt         DateTime     @default(now())\n  organization      Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([organizationId, domain])\n  @@index([domain])\n}\n\nmodel SsoConfiguration {\n  id              String       @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId  String\n  type            String\n  enabled         Boolean      @default(true)\n  encryptedConfig String\n  createdAt       DateTime     @default(now())\n  updatedAt       DateTime     @updatedAt\n  organization    Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([organizationId, type])\n}\n\nmodel ScimToken {\n  id                String       @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId    String\n  name              String\n  tokenHash         String       @unique\n  lastUsedAt        DateTime?\n  createdAt         DateTime     @default(now())\n  // F16 — 24h dual-valid rotation: on rotate the old hash moves to\n  // previousTokenHash and rotatedAt is stamped; the previous token keeps\n  // authenticating until rotatedAt + 24h so an IdP can roll over with no downtime.\n  previousTokenHash String?\n  rotatedAt         DateTime?\n  organization      Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([organizationId])\n  @@index([previousTokenHash])\n}\n\nmodel CustomRole {\n  id             String       @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId String\n  key            String\n  name           String\n  permissions    String[]\n  createdAt      DateTime     @default(now())\n  organization   Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([organizationId, key])\n}\n\nmodel SiemWebhook {\n  id               String       @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId   String\n  url              String\n  secretHash       String\n  secretCiphertext String\n  enabled          Boolean      @default(true)\n  lastDeliveredAt  DateTime?\n  // Secondary keyset cursor paired with lastDeliveredAt so same-millisecond\n  // audit rows beyond a batch boundary are not silently skipped on delivery.\n  lastDeliveredId  String?\n  createdAt        DateTime     @default(now())\n  organization     Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([organizationId])\n  @@index([organizationId, lastDeliveredAt])\n}\n\nmodel ApiKey {\n  id             String        @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId String?\n  userId         String?\n  name           String\n  keyHash        String        @unique\n  keyPrefix      String?\n  scopes         String[]\n  lastUsedAt     DateTime?\n  expiresAt      DateTime?\n  createdAt      DateTime      @default(now())\n  organization   Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  user           User?         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([userId])\n  @@index([organizationId])\n}\n\nmodel OAuthConnection {\n  id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n  userId      String\n  provider    String\n  externalId  String\n  accessHash  String\n  refreshHash String?\n  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([provider, externalId])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nenum McpDomain {\n  AI_AGENTS\n  CODE_EXECUTION\n  DATABASES\n  DEVOPS\n  DEVELOPER_TOOLS\n  COMMUNICATION\n  PRODUCTIVITY\n  KNOWLEDGE\n  WEB_BROWSING\n  SEARCH\n  CLOUD\n  SECURITY\n  FILESYSTEM\n  VERSION_CONTROL\n  MONITORING\n  OTHER\n}\n\nenum McpTransport {\n  STDIO\n  SSE\n  STREAMABLE_HTTP\n}\n\nmodel McpCatalogEntry {\n  id                  String       @id @default(cuid())\n  slug                String       @unique\n  name                String\n  description         String\n  domain              McpDomain\n  tags                String[]\n  author              String\n  homepageUrl         String?\n  iconUrl             String?\n  version             String\n  transport           McpTransport\n  configTemplate      Json\n  configSchema        Json         @default(\"{}\")\n  installCount        Int          @default(0)\n  featured            Boolean      @default(false)\n  verified            Boolean      @default(false)\n  featuredForIdePanel Boolean      @default(false)\n  // Global admin kill-switch. false = hidden from the catalog, new installs\n  // blocked, and existing installs soft-disabled (reversible on re-enable —\n  // nothing is deleted). Defaults true so every existing row stays available.\n  enabled             Boolean      @default(true)\n  publishedAt         DateTime     @default(now())\n  updatedAt           DateTime     @updatedAt\n  installs            McpInstall[]\n\n  @@index([domain])\n  @@index([featured, verified])\n  @@index([featuredForIdePanel])\n  @@index([enabled])\n}\n\nmodel McpInstall {\n  id             String          @id @default(cuid())\n  catalogEntryId String\n  userId         String\n  organizationId String?\n  alias          String\n  configJson     Json\n  enabled        Boolean         @default(true)\n  installedAt    DateTime        @default(now())\n  updatedAt      DateTime        @updatedAt\n  catalogEntry   McpCatalogEntry @relation(fields: [catalogEntryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  user           User            @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  organization   Organization?   @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([userId, alias])\n  @@index([organizationId])\n  @@index([catalogEntryId])\n}\n\n// Server-side persistence for the MCP \"Configuration\" tab (manually authored\n// `{ mcpServers: { … } }` JSON + the max sequential-LLM-step count). Replaces\n// the previous localStorage-only storage (audit H5) so the chat/agent runtime\n// can read a user's manually-configured servers — alongside their marketplace\n// installs — when assembling the live MCP tool set. One row per user.\nmodel McpUserConfig {\n  id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n  userId      String   @unique\n  configJson  Json     @default(\"{}\")\n  maxLLMSteps Int      @default(5)\n  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n}\n\n// Platform-wide (global) MCP policy — one tier ABOVE the per-org policy that\n// reuses OrganizationConnectorPolicy. One row per catalog slug; `mode` is\n// 'forced' | 'allowed' | 'blocked' (validated in the app, mirroring the org\n// policy modes). Install resolution evaluates GLOBAL first, then the org\n// policy. Absence of any row = default-open, so this is additive and inert\n// until an admin sets a policy.\nmodel McpGlobalPolicy {\n  id        String   @id @default(cuid())\n  slug      String   @unique\n  mode      String\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  @@index([mode])\n}\n\n// Server-side store for a shared conversation snapshot. Replaces embedding the\n// full conversation in the share URL: a share mints a random, HMAC-signed\n// token (stored here only as a hash) that the /share view redeems to fetch the\n// snapshot. Standalone (no FK) so a share can outlive its project/author.\nmodel ChatShare {\n  id             String    @id @default(cuid())\n  tokenHash      String    @unique\n  conversationId String\n  projectId      String\n  authorUserId   String\n  title          String?\n  payloadJson    Json\n  allowFork      Boolean   @default(false)\n  expiresAt      DateTime?\n  revokedAt      DateTime?\n  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())\n\n  @@index([projectId])\n  @@index([authorUserId])\n}\n\nenum AgentRunStatus {\n  PENDING\n  RUNNING\n  COMPLETE\n  PARTIAL\n  FAILED\n}\n\nenum AgentRunResultStatus {\n  COMPLETE\n  PARTIAL\n  FAILED\n}\n\nmodel AgentRun {\n  id             String           @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId String?\n  userId         String?\n  conversationId String?\n  projectId      String?\n  mode           String\n  status         AgentRunStatus   @default(PENDING)\n  reason         String?\n  rolesPlanned   Json\n  startedAt      DateTime         @default(now())\n  completedAt    DateTime?\n  metadata       Json             @default(\"{}\")\n  results        AgentRunResult[]\n  consensus      ConsensusRecord?\n  user           User?            @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n  organization   Organization?    @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n\n  @@index([organizationId, startedAt])\n  @@index([userId, startedAt])\n  @@index([conversationId])\n}\n\nmodel AgentRunResult {\n  id           String               @id @default(cuid())\n  runId        String\n  roleId       String\n  status       AgentRunResultStatus\n  summary      String\n  files        Json                 @default(\"[]\")\n  risks        Json                 @default(\"[]\")\n  verification Json                 @default(\"[]\")\n  rawOutput    String?\n  errorMessage String?\n  startedAt    DateTime             @default(now())\n  completedAt  DateTime?\n  run          AgentRun             @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([runId, roleId])\n  @@index([runId])\n}\n\nenum ConsensusAlgorithm {\n  QUORUM\n  BYZANTINE_PBFT\n  WEIGHTED_PLURALITY\n}\n\nenum ConsensusOutcome {\n  ACCEPTED\n  REJECTED\n  PARTIAL\n  ABSTAINED\n}\n\nmodel ConsensusRecord {\n  id             String             @id @default(cuid())\n  runId          String             @unique\n  algorithm      ConsensusAlgorithm\n  threshold      Float\n  outcome        ConsensusOutcome\n  agreementScore Float\n  claimVotes     Json\n  conflicts      Json               @default(\"[]\")\n  consolidated   Json\n  rounds         Int                @default(1)\n  durationMs     Int\n  createdAt      DateTime           @default(now())\n  run            AgentRun           @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n}\n\n/// Runtime/K8s orchestration state owned by services/workspace-manager.\n/// Distinct from the user-facing Workspace model (which carries projectId\n/// and runtimeMode for the IDE): this row tracks the actual pod, PVC,\n/// service and agent-token-secret names allocated to the workspace, plus\n/// the lifecycle status and the last-active timestamp used by the GC sweep.\n/// The id matches the workspaceId used by services/api and the K8s object\n/// names (\"workspace-${id}\", \"pvc-${id}\", \"agent-token-${id}\"), so this row\n/// is effectively the canonical state shared between workspace-manager\n/// replicas — replacing the file-backed JsonWorkspaceStore.\nmodel WorkspaceRuntime {\n  id                   String    @id\n  orgId                String\n  projectId            String\n  plan                 Json\n  status               String\n  pvcName              String\n  podName              String\n  serviceName          String\n  agentTokenSecretName String\n  error                String?\n  createdAt            DateTime  @default(now())\n  lastActiveAt         DateTime  @default(now())\n  // Last time this runtime's active compute was metered to the billing usage\n  // ledger (P4 metering emitter). The GC meters the window from here (or\n  // createdAt) to lastActiveAt on stop, then advances this marker — idempotent\n  // across manager restarts. Null until first metered.\n  lastMeteredAt        DateTime?\n  // RR-CODEX-14 (P3): durable purge barrier. Once an account purge freezes this\n  // runtime, NO reprovision (start / restart / agent-token / PVC / Pod / Secret /\n  // Service) may recreate it until the tombstone. purgeFenceToken identifies the\n  // owning purge plan; the barrier is released on abandon and recoverable.\n  purgeFrozen          Boolean   @default(false)\n  purgeFenceToken      String?\n  // RR-CODEX-14 v5 (R-P3-04): when the barrier was set, so an ORPHANED barrier\n  // (owning purge crashed before unfreeze) is recoverable by age via the manager's\n  // reconcileStaleWorkspaceFreezes — never left durably frozen with no owner.\n  purgeFrozenAt        DateTime?\n  updatedAt            DateTime  @updatedAt\n\n  @@index([orgId])\n  @@index([projectId])\n  @@index([status, lastActiveAt])\n}\n\n// --- Integrations panel: connector catalog, user-scoped connections,\n// per-project links, enterprise overrides, reconnection alerts,\n// integration feature requests. See docs/INTEGRATIONS_MASTER_PLAN.md.\n\nmodel ConnectorCatalog {\n  id          String @id @default(cuid())\n  provider    String @unique\n  displayName String\n  description String\n  category    String\n  authType    String\n  section     String\n  logoUrl     String\n\n  defaultClientId        String?\n  defaultClientSecretEnc String?\n  authorizeUrl           String?\n  tokenUrl               String?\n  revokeUrl              String?\n  userInfoUrl            String?\n  defaultScopes          String[]\n  availableScopes        String[]\n\n  apiKeyFields       Json?\n  apiKeyTestEndpoint String?\n\n  triggersSupported   String[]\n  triggerDescriptions Json     @default(\"{}\")\n\n  webhookSupport          Boolean @default(false)\n  webhookSignatureScheme  String?\n  webhookSigningSecretEnc String?\n\n  minPlanTier         String  @default(\"free\")\n  forAgentUse         Boolean @default(true)\n  displayOrder        Int     @default(0)\n  featuredForIdePanel Boolean @default(false)\n  enabled             Boolean @default(true)\n\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  @@index([section, enabled])\n  @@index([category])\n}\n\nmodel UserConnection {\n  id                   String @id @default(cuid())\n  userId               String\n  provider             String\n  externalAccountId    String\n  externalAccountLabel String\n\n  accessTokenEncrypted  String?\n  refreshTokenEncrypted String?\n  apiKeyFieldsEncrypted Json?\n\n  scopes            String[]\n  tokenExpiresAt    DateTime?\n  status            String    @default(\"active\")\n  lastUsedAt        DateTime?\n  // Cursor for the background token health-check sweep, kept separate from the\n  // user-facing lastUsedAt so the sweep no longer clobbers \"last used\".\n  lastHealthCheckAt DateTime?\n  forAgentUse       Boolean   @default(true)\n\n  oauthAppSource     String  @default(\"e_code_default\")\n  oauthAppOverrideId String?\n\n  createdByUserId String\n  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt       DateTime  @updatedAt\n  revokedAt       DateTime?\n\n  user               User                          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  oauthAppOverride   OrganizationOAuthAppOverride? @relation(fields: [oauthAppOverrideId], references: [id])\n  projectLinks       ProjectConnectionLink[]\n  reconnectionAlerts ReconnectionAlert[]\n\n  @@unique([userId, provider, externalAccountId])\n  @@index([userId, provider])\n  @@index([status])\n  // Background token-health sweep cursors on lastHealthCheckAt; was a full-scan.\n  @@index([lastHealthCheckAt])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectConnectionLink {\n  id               String    @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId        String\n  userConnectionId String\n  linkedByUserId   String\n  linkedAt         DateTime  @default(now())\n  unlinkedAt       DateTime?\n\n  project        Project        @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  userConnection UserConnection @relation(fields: [userConnectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  linkedByUser   User           @relation(\"LinkedByUser\", fields: [linkedByUserId], references: [id])\n\n  @@unique([projectId, userConnectionId])\n  @@index([projectId])\n  @@index([userConnectionId])\n  // \"who linked this\" lookups + future user-offboarding scans; was a full-scan.\n  @@index([linkedByUserId])\n}\n\nmodel OrganizationOAuthAppOverride {\n  id                    String    @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId        String\n  provider              String\n  clientId              String\n  clientSecretEncrypted String\n  scopes                String[]\n  configuredByUserId    String\n  testedAt              DateTime?\n  testStatus            String?\n  testError             String?\n  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt\n\n  organization     Organization     @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  configuredByUser User             @relation(\"ConfiguredByUser\", fields: [configuredByUserId], references: [id])\n  userConnections  UserConnection[]\n\n  @@unique([organizationId, provider])\n}\n\nmodel OrganizationConnectorPolicy {\n  id                String   @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId    String\n  provider          String\n  enabled           Boolean  @default(true)\n  allowedRoleKeys   String[]\n  rateLimitOverride Int?\n  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  organization Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([organizationId, provider])\n}\n\nmodel ReconnectionAlert {\n  id               String    @id @default(cuid())\n  userConnectionId String\n  reason           String\n  detectedAt       DateTime  @default(now())\n  resolvedAt       DateTime?\n  notifiedAt       DateTime?\n\n  userConnection UserConnection @relation(fields: [userConnectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([userConnectionId, resolvedAt])\n}\n\n/// Per-user in-app notification feed (2026-07-02). A durable, user-scoped\n/// inbox surfaced in the SaaS account area: producers write a row, the user\n/// lists unread + recent and marks items read. Distinct from ReconnectionAlert\n/// (a connector-domain resolve queue) — this is the general feed. The first\n/// real producer is the connector reconnection alert: when one is raised the\n/// API also drops a Notification so the feed is non-empty in reality.\nmodel Notification {\n  id        String    @id @default(cuid())\n  userId    String\n  /// Coarse routing/tone bucket, aligned with the preferences surfaces:\n  /// \"security\" | \"billing\" | \"deployments\" | \"team\" | \"system\".\n  category  String    @default(\"system\")\n  title     String\n  body      String?\n  /// Optional in-app link the notification points at (e.g. /account/connections).\n  linkUrl   String?\n  /// Free-form producer metadata (e.g. the source alert id / provider) so the\n  /// feed can be traced back to its origin without extra columns.\n  metadata  Json?\n  readAt    DateTime?\n  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())\n\n  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  // Feed query is \"this user's rows, unread first / newest first\"; the partial\n  // shape is covered well enough by the composite index below.\n  @@index([userId, readAt, createdAt])\n}\n\nmodel NewsletterSubscriber {\n  id             String    @id @default(cuid())\n  /// Normalized (lowercased, trimmed) address; unique so re-subscribing is an\n  /// idempotent upsert rather than a duplicate row.\n  email          String    @unique\n  /// Where the subscription came from (\"footer\", \"newsletter-page\", ...).\n  source         String    @default(\"footer\")\n  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())\n  confirmedAt    DateTime?\n  unsubscribedAt DateTime?\n}\n\n/// Sales-contact leads submitted through the public /contact-sales form.\n/// The row id doubles as the reference number quoted back to the prospect\n/// (first 8 chars, uppercased), so sales can locate the lead from the\n/// reference alone.\nmodel ContactRequest {\n  id        String   @id @default(cuid())\n  email     String\n  name      String?\n  company   String\n  teamSize  String?\n  message   String\n  /// Marketing page the form was submitted from (\"/contact-sales\", ...).\n  pagePath  String?\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n}\n\nmodel IntegrationFeatureRequest {\n  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())\n  userId             String\n  organizationId     String?\n  integrationName    String\n  useCaseDescription String\n  status             String   @default(\"pending\")\n  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())\n\n  user         User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n\n  @@index([status])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\n/// Delivery / bounce / complaint notifications received from transactional\n/// email providers. The recipient is stored verbatim (not joined to User) so\n/// we can keep history for addresses that don't have an account — password\n/// reset and email-verification flows fire before the user exists.\nmodel EmailDeliveryEvent {\n  id              String   @id @default(cuid())\n  provider        String\n  providerEventId String\n  type            String\n  email           String\n  emailMessageId  String?\n  subject         String?\n  fromAddress     String?\n  payload         Json\n  receivedAt      DateTime @default(now())\n\n  @@unique([provider, providerEventId])\n  @@index([email])\n  @@index([type])\n  @@index([emailMessageId])\n}\n\n// ===========================================================================\n// Replit-parity billing: credit wallet, effort-based checkpoints, and the\n// admin-owned provider/model registry. All additive and dormant until the\n// `BILLING_CREDITS_ENABLED` / `MODEL_REGISTRY_DB` flags are turned on, so the\n// existing flat-rate Stripe billing path is unaffected. See\n// docs/REPLIT_PARITY_SPEC.md.\n// ===========================================================================\n\n/// One USD-cent credit balance per organization. `balanceCents` is a\n/// materialized cache of the sum of `CreditLedger.deltaCents`; the ledger is\n/// the source of truth. `budgetCapCents` null = pay-as-you-go disabled.\nmodel CreditWallet {\n  id                        String         @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId            String         @unique\n  balanceCents              Int            @default(0)\n  currency                  String         @default(\"usd\")\n  // Replit \"Usage Limit\": cap on usage-based spend past included credits.\n  budgetCapCents            Int?\n  // Replit \"Service Shutdown Limit\": suspend usage-based services when reached.\n  serviceShutdownCents      Int?\n  autoTopupCents            Int?\n  // Replit usage-based spend alerts (50/80/100%). De-dup marker: the highest\n  // alert rung sent in the current billing period, and that period's start, so\n  // each rung fires once and the ladder resets every period. Dormant until\n  // BILLING_CREDITS_ENABLED. See spend-alerts.ts.\n  lastSpendAlertPct         Int?\n  lastSpendAlertPeriodStart DateTime?\n  createdAt                 DateTime       @default(now())\n  updatedAt                 DateTime       @updatedAt\n  organization              Organization   @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  entries                   CreditLedger[]\n}\n\n/// Purchased credit pack (Replit). Credits expire 6 months after purchase, are\n/// consumed earliest-expiring-first, and do NOT roll over after expiry.\n/// `remainingCents` is decremented as the pack is drawn down.\nmodel CreditPack {\n  id                    String       @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId        String\n  purchasedCents        Int\n  remainingCents        Int\n  expiresAt             DateTime\n  stripePaymentIntentId String?\n  createdAt             DateTime     @default(now())\n  organization          Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([organizationId, expiresAt])\n}\n\nenum CreditEntryKind {\n  GRANT\n  CONSUMPTION\n  PAYG_CHARGE\n  REFUND\n  ADJUSTMENT\n  EXPIRY\n}\n\n/// Append-only credit movements. Positive deltas are grants/refunds, negative\n/// are consumption/charges. `checkpointId` links a CONSUMPTION to the agent\n/// request that produced it. `expiresAt` supports daily/monthly grants that do\n/// not roll over (Starter plan).\nmodel CreditLedger {\n  id             String          @id @default(cuid())\n  walletId       String\n  organizationId String\n  deltaCents     Int\n  kind           CreditEntryKind\n  reason         String\n  checkpointId   String?\n  expiresAt      DateTime?\n  metadata       Json?\n  createdAt      DateTime        @default(now())\n  wallet         CreditWallet    @relation(fields: [walletId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  organization   Organization    @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  // NOTE: a PARTIAL UNIQUE index \"CreditLedger_org_checkpoint_payg_key\" on\n  // (organizationId, checkpointId) WHERE kind='PAYG_CHARGE' is defined in raw SQL\n  // (migration 0045) — Prisma's schema can't express a WHERE-filtered unique index.\n  // It backs recordPaygCharge's atomic create+catch-P2002 dedup. Do not drop it.\n\n  @@index([organizationId, createdAt])\n  @@index([walletId, createdAt])\n  @@index([checkpointId])\n  @@index([kind, expiresAt])\n  // Org-scoped credit-expiry sweep filters organizationId + kind + expiresAt\n  // together; the kind/expiresAt-only index wasn't org-scoped.\n  @@index([organizationId, kind, expiresAt])\n}\n\nenum CheckpointStatus {\n  PENDING\n  COMPLETED\n  FAILED\n}\n\n/// Effort-based checkpoint: exactly one per agent request. Bundles the real\n/// effort (tokens + wall-time + attributed compute) into a single user-visible\n/// credit charge (proof-of-work). `creditCents` is always >= the real provider\n/// cost (`rawProviderCents`) by the configured margin.\nmodel AgentCheckpoint {\n  id               String           @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId   String\n  userId           String?\n  projectId        String?\n  conversationId   String?\n  runId            String?\n  status           CheckpointStatus @default(PENDING)\n  highPowerModel   Boolean          @default(false)\n  extendedThinking Boolean          @default(false)\n  // Replit Agent build tier (lite | economy | power) and Turbo mode (Pro:\n  // ~2.5x faster, up to ~6x cost). Both feed the effort-based estimate.\n  buildTier        String           @default(\"power\")\n  turboMode        Boolean          @default(false)\n  inputTokens      Int              @default(0)\n  outputTokens     Int              @default(0)\n  wallMs           Int              @default(0)\n  computeCents     Int              @default(0)\n  rawProviderCents Int              @default(0)\n  creditCents      Int              @default(0)\n  startedAt        DateTime         @default(now())\n  completedAt      DateTime?\n  organization     Organization     @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([organizationId, startedAt])\n  @@index([projectId])\n  @@index([runId])\n}\n\n/// Replit-parity per-user spend limit (Enterprise). An admin can cap an\n/// individual member's usage-based spend below the org/workspace default; the\n/// per-member override takes precedence over the org budget cap.\nmodel UserSpendLimit {\n  id             String       @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId String\n  userId         String\n  limitCents     Int\n  createdAt      DateTime     @default(now())\n  updatedAt      DateTime     @updatedAt\n  organization   Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  user           User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([organizationId, userId])\n  @@index([organizationId])\n}\n\n/// Admin-owned AI provider registry. `apiKeySecret` is the *name* of a secret\n/// in the platform secret manager — never the key material itself.\nmodel ProviderConfig {\n  id           String        @id @default(cuid())\n  provider     String        @unique\n  displayName  String\n  enabled      Boolean       @default(false)\n  apiKeySecret String?\n  /// Admin-set platform API key for this provider, encrypted with encryptJson\n  /// (write-only, never returned). Distinct from `apiKeySecret`, which holds only\n  /// the NAME of a secret. Runtime resolves DB-first → *_API_KEY env fallback.\n  apiKeyEnc    String?\n  baseUrl      String?\n  byokAllowed  Boolean       @default(false)\n  createdAt    DateTime      @default(now())\n  updatedAt    DateTime      @updatedAt\n  models       ModelConfig[]\n}\n\n/// Admin-owned model registry. Users may only see/use models with\n/// `enabled = true` whose `enabledPlans` include their plan. Pricing here drives\n/// effort-based credit cost.\nmodel ModelConfig {\n  id               String         @id @default(cuid())\n  providerConfigId String\n  modelId          String\n  displayName      String\n  enabled          Boolean        @default(false)\n  enabledPlans     Json\n  isHighPower      Boolean        @default(false)\n  supportsThinking Boolean        @default(false)\n  inputCentsPerM   Int\n  outputCentsPerM  Int\n  contextWindow    Int\n  createdAt        DateTime       @default(now())\n  updatedAt        DateTime       @updatedAt\n  providerConfig   ProviderConfig @relation(fields: [providerConfigId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([providerConfigId, modelId])\n  @@index([enabled])\n}\n\nenum DatabaseInstanceStatus {\n  PROVISIONING\n  ACTIVE\n  SUSPENDED\n  DELETED\n}\n\n/// Managed Postgres database for a project (Replit \"Database\" tab). Phase-1\n/// scaffold for point-in-time rollback: the row models the instance and its\n/// retention window; provisioning + WAL-based PITR are wired in later phases and\n/// gated behind DB_ROLLBACK_ENABLED, so this table is dormant until then.\n/// `retentionDays` is the plan-derived PITR window (Pro = 28).\nmodel DatabaseInstance {\n  id             String                 @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId      String\n  organizationId String\n  // P2d dev/prod split: a project has a `development` instance (its workspace\n  // DB) and, once published, a separate `production` instance. Existing rows\n  // backfill to 'development', preserving the prior one-per-project behaviour.\n  environment    String                 @default(\"development\")\n  status         DatabaseInstanceStatus @default(PROVISIONING)\n  engine         String                 @default(\"postgres\")\n  region         String?\n  sizeBytes      BigInt                 @default(0)\n  retentionDays  Int                    @default(7)\n  pitrEnabled    Boolean                @default(false)\n  createdAt      DateTime               @default(now())\n  updatedAt      DateTime               @updatedAt\n  project        Project                @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  snapshots      DatabaseSnapshot[]\n  restores       DatabaseRestore[]\n\n  @@unique([projectId, environment])\n  @@index([organizationId])\n  @@index([status])\n}\n\n/// A recovery point for a DatabaseInstance — either a scheduled automatic\n/// snapshot or a user-requested manual one. `lsn` records the Postgres WAL\n/// position so a restore can target an exact point in time; `expiresAt` is the\n/// retention horizon (older snapshots are pruned). Dormant until PITR ships.\nmodel DatabaseSnapshot {\n  id                 String           @id @default(cuid())\n  databaseInstanceId String\n  kind               String           @default(\"auto\")\n  label              String?\n  lsn                String?\n  sizeBytes          BigInt           @default(0)\n  storageKey         String?\n  createdByUserId    String?\n  createdAt          DateTime         @default(now())\n  expiresAt          DateTime?\n  databaseInstance   DatabaseInstance @relation(fields: [databaseInstanceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([databaseInstanceId, createdAt])\n  @@index([expiresAt])\n}\n\nenum DatabaseRestoreStatus {\n  PENDING\n  RUNNING\n  COMPLETED\n  FAILED\n}\n\n/// A point-in-time restore request for a DatabaseInstance. Targets either a\n/// specific snapshot or an arbitrary `targetTimestamp` within the retention\n/// window (true PITR). Status moves PENDING → RUNNING → COMPLETED/FAILED. The\n/// restore executor is a later phase; rows can be created dormant for the UI.\nmodel DatabaseRestore {\n  id                 String                @id @default(cuid())\n  databaseInstanceId String\n  snapshotId         String?\n  targetTimestamp    DateTime?\n  status             DatabaseRestoreStatus @default(PENDING)\n  requestedByUserId  String?\n  error              String?\n  createdAt          DateTime              @default(now())\n  startedAt          DateTime?\n  completedAt        DateTime?\n  databaseInstance   DatabaseInstance      @relation(fields: [databaseInstanceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([databaseInstanceId, createdAt])\n  @@index([status])\n  // \"restores requested by user\" lookups; was a full-scan (no FK on this column).\n  @@index([requestedByUserId])\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Scheduled tasks (cron). Backs BOTH the Workflows panel schedules AND the\n// Replit-parity \"Scheduled\" deployment type: a command that runs on a cron,\n// exits, and is billed for its RUN TIME (duration x machine size) rather than\n// 24/7. Before this, cron expressions were validated and a nextRunAt was\n// computed, but nothing ever fired them — the feature was dead.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nenum ScheduledTaskKind {\n  /// Runs an existing Workflows-panel workflow (its ordered steps).\n  WORKFLOW\n  /// Replit \"Scheduled Deployment\": one shell command, on a cron.\n  DEPLOYMENT\n}\n\nenum ScheduledTaskRunStatus {\n  RUNNING\n  SUCCESS\n  FAILED\n  TIMED_OUT\n  /// The previous run was still RUNNING when this tick fired (concurrencyPolicy=FORBID).\n  SKIPPED\n  CANCELED\n}\n\n/// One cron-scheduled unit of work owned by a project. `nextRunAt` is the claim\n/// token: the scheduler advances it inside a conditional UPDATE, so exactly one\n/// api replica can ever own a given tick (no distributed lock needed).\nmodel ScheduledTask {\n  id              String             @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId  String\n  projectId       String\n  kind            ScheduledTaskKind  @default(DEPLOYMENT)\n  name            String\n  /// Shell command for DEPLOYMENT tasks (run as `sh -lc <command>` in the project sandbox).\n  command         String             @default(\"\")\n  /// For WORKFLOW tasks: the workflow id inside VIBECORE_WORKFLOWS_STATE.\n  workflowId      Int?\n  /// 5-field cron expression, already normalized.\n  cron            String\n  /// IANA timezone the cron fields are interpreted in.\n  timezone        String             @default(\"UTC\")\n  /// Machine size key. The size catalogue itself is owned elsewhere; this is the field only.\n  machineSize     String             @default(\"shared-0.5\")\n  enabled         Boolean            @default(true)\n  /// Hard kill after this many seconds.\n  timeoutSeconds  Int                @default(900)\n  /// FORBID (skip if the previous run is still going) | ALLOW.\n  concurrency     String             @default(\"FORBID\")\n  /// Replit parity: a failed scheduled run is NOT retried by default.\n  maxRetries      Int                @default(0)\n  notifyOnFailure Boolean            @default(true)\n  lastRunAt       DateTime?\n  lastStatus      String?\n  /// Next fire time (UTC). NULL when disabled.\n  nextRunAt       DateTime?\n  createdByUserId String?\n  createdAt       DateTime           @default(now())\n  updatedAt       DateTime           @updatedAt\n  runs            ScheduledTaskRun[]\n\n  @@unique([projectId, kind, workflowId])\n  /// The scheduler's hot query: enabled tasks whose nextRunAt is due.\n  @@index([enabled, nextRunAt])\n  @@index([projectId])\n  @@index([organizationId])\n}\n\n/// One execution. Holds the FULL captured stdout+stderr, the real exit code, the\n/// real duration, and the billing outcome for that duration.\nmodel ScheduledTaskRun {\n  id             String                 @id @default(cuid())\n  taskId         String\n  organizationId String\n  projectId      String\n  status         ScheduledTaskRunStatus @default(RUNNING)\n  /// \"schedule\" | \"manual\"\n  trigger        String                 @default(\"schedule\")\n  attempt        Int                    @default(1)\n  /// The cron instant this run is for (may differ from startedAt under load).\n  scheduledFor   DateTime\n  startedAt      DateTime               @default(now())\n  finishedAt     DateTime?\n  durationMs     Int?\n  exitCode       Int?\n  /// Full captured output (stdout + stderr), not a tail.\n  logs           String                 @default(\"\")\n  error          String?\n  machineSize    String?\n  /// Billed compute units for this run (duration x size). NULL until metered.\n  computeUnits   Float?\n  costCents      Float?\n  meteredAt      DateTime?\n  task           ScheduledTask          @relation(fields: [taskId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([taskId, startedAt])\n  @@index([projectId, startedAt])\n  @@index([status])\n}\n\n/// Versioned Agent Routing Card: maps agent modes (Lite/Economy/Power) and\n/// switches (High effort/Turbo) + the harness classifier to concrete provider\n/// models with cost-of-revenue and user pricing. `data` is the serialized\n/// AgentRoutingCard document (packages/billing agent-routing.ts). A config\n/// change inserts a NEW version and closes the previous one (effectiveTo) —\n/// never a deployment, never a mutation of history.\nmodel AgentRoutingCard {\n  id              String    @id @default(cuid())\n  version         Int       @unique\n  active          Boolean   @default(false)\n  data            Json\n  effectiveFrom   DateTime  @default(now())\n  effectiveTo     DateTime?\n  /// Date the cost-of-revenue figures were sourced from provider pricing.\n  sourceDate      String?\n  createdByUserId String?\n  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())\n  createdBy       User?     @relation(\"AgentRoutingCardAuthor\", fields: [createdByUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n\n  @@index([active])\n}\n\n/// One row per routed agent LLM call (admin-only, never shown to the client):\n/// who called, which mode/switches, whether high-effort escalated, the REAL\n/// provider+model used, tokens, cost-of-revenue, credits billed and margin.\n/// Cents are stored as millicents (Int) to keep fractional cost exact.\nmodel AgentCallLog {\n  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())\n  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())\n  userId             String?\n  organizationId     String?\n  projectId          String?\n  /// lite | economy | power\n  mode               String\n  highEffort         Boolean  @default(false)\n  /// true when high-effort actually escalated this call to the escalation line\n  escalated          Boolean  @default(false)\n  turbo              Boolean  @default(false)\n  /// Routing line that priced the call: mode key, high-effort, turbo or classifier.\n  lineKey            String\n  provider           String\n  model              String\n  tokensIn           Int      @default(0)\n  tokensOut          Int      @default(0)\n  /// Coût de revient in millicents (1/1000 cent).\n  costMillicents     Int      @default(0)\n  /// Credits billed to the user, in cents (0 when billedToUser=false).\n  creditCents        Int      @default(0)\n  /// creditCents*1000 - costMillicents (negative = platform absorbed cost).\n  marginMillicents   Int      @default(0)\n  billedToUser       Boolean  @default(true)\n  routingCardVersion Int\n  /// chat | classifier | continuation…\n  source             String   @default(\"chat\")\n\n  @@index([createdAt])\n  @@index([lineKey, createdAt])\n  @@index([organizationId, createdAt])\n  @@index([projectId, createdAt])\n}\n\n/// A secure project remix (fork) run. Tracks the normative state machine\n/// (SNAPSHOT_PINNED → CREDENTIALS_DETACHED → CLONING → DB_FORKING →\n/// STORAGE_POLICY_APPLIED → SCANNING → INDEXING → COMPLETED) so the\n/// credentials-detached-before-cloning invariant is auditable. `detachedKeys`\n/// holds ONLY secret/env KEYS (references) — never a value. `scanFindings`\n/// records materialized-secret hits (key + location, never the value).\nmodel RemixJob {\n  id               String   @id @default(cuid())\n  sourceProjectId  String\n  targetProjectId  String?\n  organizationId   String\n  actorUserId      String?\n  state            String   @default(\"SNAPSHOT_PINNED\")\n  /// IMMUTABLE source release the clone reproduces. When set, CLONING reads the\n  /// files from this pinned ProjectSnapshot archive (not the live source), so a\n  /// gallery remix is reproducible from the exact published release. NULL for a\n  /// legacy live-source remix. This is the provenance pin (I-RMX-PIN).\n  sourceSnapshotId String?\n  /// The gallery listing this remix was launched from, if any (provenance).\n  sourceListingId  String?\n  /// { secretKeys: string[], envVarKeys: string[] } — references only.\n  detachedKeys     Json?\n  /// DETACH | CLONE | SHARE_WITH_CONSENT\n  storagePolicy    String   @default(\"DETACH\")\n  /// SecretScanFinding[] { path, secretKey, line } — never the value.\n  scanFindings     Json?\n  /// Count of value-lines scrubbed out of the clone during CLONING.\n  scrubbedCount    Int      @default(0)\n  /// VERSIONED license captured at remix time from the source listing —\n  /// { licenseId, licenseTextSha256, sourceListingId, capturedAt }. Immutable on\n  /// the job: later edits to the listing's license never rewrite what THIS remix\n  /// was accepted under (I-RMX-3, P0-V3-05). Null for a same-org self-remix.\n  licenseSnapshot  Json?\n  /// Version of the remix consent text the REMIXER explicitly accepted before\n  /// the clone ran (REMIX_CONSENT_VERSION at accept time). Null = no consent\n  /// captured (same-org self-remix only — a gallery remix REQUIRES it).\n  consentVersion   String?\n  /// PiiFinding[] { path, kind, line } — kind of PII masked, never the value.\n  piiFindings      Json?\n  /// Count of PII spans masked out of the clone during SOURCE_SANITIZED.\n  piiMaskedCount   Int      @default(0)\n  /// Honest marker: was a physical isolated DB provisioned, or deferred?\n  dbForked         Boolean  @default(false)\n  error            String?\n  createdAt        DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  @@index([sourceProjectId])\n  @@index([organizationId, createdAt])\n}\n\n/// A secure project import run (DOMAIN_MODEL §2). Tracks the normative state\n/// machine (RECEIVED → STAGING_ISOLATED → SCANNING → QUARANTINED →\n/// AWAITING_USER_ACTION → COMMITTING → COMMITTED, with ROLLING_BACK / EXPIRED /\n/// CANCELLED cleanup branches). `findings` holds REDACTED secret findings only\n/// (never a raw value); `consent` records the per-finding keep/redact decision.\n/// `targetProjectId` is set ONLY at the atomic COMMIT — it is null on every\n/// non-committed terminal state (proving the target was never touched).\nmodel ImportJob {\n  id              String    @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId  String\n  actorUserId     String?\n  /// One of the 12 hub tiles (github|bitbucket|vercel|figma|claude|bolt|lovable|base44|zip|spreadsheet|previous-agent-export|empty)\n  provider        String\n  state           String    @default(\"RECEIVED\")\n  sourceRef       String?\n  /// ImportSecretFinding[] { path, line, kind, preview } — redacted, no value.\n  findings        Json?\n  /// ConsentDecision { \"path:line\": \"keep\"|\"redact\" }.\n  consent         Json?\n  /// Set only at COMMITTED. Null everywhere else = target never mounted.\n  targetProjectId String?\n  stagedFileCount Int       @default(0)\n  redactedCount   Int       @default(0)\n  /// E-CODE DECISION (not Replit parity): idempotent credit reservation marker.\n  creditsReserved Boolean   @default(false)\n  error           String?\n  expiresAt       DateTime?\n  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt       DateTime  @updatedAt\n\n  @@index([organizationId, createdAt])\n  @@index([state])\n}\n\n/// A curated public Gallery listing (TPL-02). Mirrors the CONFIRMED\n/// replit.com/gallery surface: a browsable grid of published apps with an\n/// author, public stats (views / uses), a category, a detail page, an outbound\n/// \"View App\" link, and a Remix CTA.\n///\n/// CURATION, NOT SELF-SERVICE. Per DEC-GALLERY-NO-SELF-PUBLISH (Replit's\n/// \"Submit your App\" is an external Typeform → human intake), rows are created\n/// by a curator/seed, never by an in-product self-service Publish button. The\n/// `status` gate is the curation boundary; only PUBLISHED rows are shown.\n///\n/// `sourceSnapshotId` pins the IMMUTABLE release a Remix reproduces — a\n/// ProjectSnapshot archive of the source project taken at curation time. Remix\n/// clones from THAT snapshot, so what a user forks matches the published\n/// listing regardless of later edits to the source project.\nmodel GalleryListing {\n  id                  String    @id @default(cuid())\n  slug                String    @unique\n  title               String\n  description         String\n  category            String\n  /// Free-form display tags ([\"react\",\"stripe\"]). Not a taxonomy.\n  tags                String[]  @default([])\n  /// PUBLISHED (visible) | PENDING_REVIEW (curated, not yet live) | UNPUBLISHED.\n  status              String    @default(\"PUBLISHED\")\n  featured            Boolean   @default(false)\n  sourceProjectId     String\n  /// Immutable release pin — the ProjectSnapshot a Remix reproduces.\n  sourceSnapshotId    String\n  /// Curated author display (denormalized so a listing survives author changes).\n  authorName          String\n  authorUserId        String?\n  /// Outbound \"View App\" link to the deployed app (may be null pre-deploy).\n  appUrl              String?\n  /// Card preview image (a real rendered screenshot). Root-relative static\n  /// asset (/gallery-apps/<id>/thumbnail.png) or an https URL; null renders\n  /// the text-only card.\n  thumbnailUrl        String?\n  /// FAIL-CLOSED (directive 20/07) : un projet publié ordinaire est\n  /// ALL_RIGHTS_RESERVED, non-remixable. remixAllowed ne passe true qu'avec\n  /// une licence EXPLICITE + confirmation des droits + politique PII acceptée.\n  remixAllowed        Boolean   @default(false)\n  /// License identifier declared at curation (e.g. an SPDX id like \"MIT\").\n  /// Null = the author declared no license (surfaced as such — never invented).\n  licenseId           String?\n  /// VERSIONED license text snapshot captured at curation. What a remixer\n  /// accepts is THIS text, pinned by its sha256 onto the RemixJob.\n  licenseText         String?\n  /// sha256 of licenseText — the version pin recorded on every remix.\n  licenseTextSha256   String?\n  /// Version of the PII-sharing consent the AUTHOR explicitly gave at curation\n  /// (data ships unmasked). Null = no consent → PII is masked on every remix.\n  piiConsentVersion   String?\n  /// TRACE AUDITABLE des confirmations exigées pour rendre un listing remixable\n  /// (P0-V3-05, réserve #8). Avant la migration 0081 elles étaient validées à la\n  /// curation puis JAMAIS écrites : la confirmation des droits par le curateur\n  /// était inauditable a posteriori. Horodatage + acteur (userId de l'admin qui\n  /// a curé). Null = jamais confirmé.\n  rightsConfirmedAt   DateTime?\n  rightsConfirmedBy   String?\n  piiPolicyAcceptedAt DateTime?\n  piiPolicyAcceptedBy String?\n  viewCount           Int       @default(0)\n  useCount            Int       @default(0)\n  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())\n  publishedAt         DateTime?\n\n  sourceProject Project @relation(\"ProjectGalleryListings\", fields: [sourceProjectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  author        User?   @relation(\"UserGalleryListings\", fields: [authorUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n\n  @@index([status, category])\n  @@index([status, featured])\n  @@index([status, createdAt])\n}\n\n// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// CANONICAL DOUBLE-ENTRY LEDGER (C1 / P0-V3-12)\n// Supersedes the single-entry CreditWallet.balanceCents \"porte-monnaie\". Every\n// posted transaction balances per currency (Σ debits == Σ credits); posted\n// transactions + entries are IMMUTABLE (DB triggers in migration 0078) — a\n// correction is a NEW reversing transaction, never a mutation. Amounts are exact\n// integer minor units (BigInt); FX is exact rational (num/den). No relation to\n// Organization is declared (plain organizationId, like UsageReservation) to keep\n// the migration self-contained.\n// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nenum LedgerAccountType {\n  ASSET\n  LIABILITY\n  REVENUE\n  EXPENSE\n  EQUITY\n}\n\nenum LedgerEntryDirection {\n  DEBIT\n  CREDIT\n}\n\nenum LedgerReservationStatus {\n  ACTIVE\n  COMMITTED\n  COMPENSATED\n  RELEASED\n  EXPIRED\n}\n\nenum LedgerReconciliationStatus {\n  OK\n  DISCREPANCY\n}\n\nmodel LedgerAccount {\n  id             String            @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId String\n  /// Stable account key: user_credits | reserved | revenue | provider_cost |\n  /// fx_clearing | fx_rounding | tax_payable | refunds | budget_hold ...\n  key            String\n  type           LedgerAccountType\n  currency       String\n  createdAt      DateTime          @default(now())\n  entries        LedgerEntry[]\n\n  @@unique([organizationId, key, currency])\n  @@index([organizationId])\n}\n\nmodel LedgerTransaction {\n  id              String              @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId  String\n  reason          String\n  /// Idempotency key (unique per org when set). NULL rows are not deduped.\n  idempotencyKey  String?\n  /// Compensation: points at the original transaction this one reverses.\n  reversalOfId    String?\n  rateCardVersion Int?\n  postedAt        DateTime            @default(now())\n  metadata        Json?\n  entries         LedgerEntry[]\n  reversalOf      LedgerTransaction?  @relation(\"LedgerReversal\", fields: [reversalOfId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n  reversals       LedgerTransaction[] @relation(\"LedgerReversal\")\n\n  @@unique([organizationId, idempotencyKey])\n  @@index([organizationId, postedAt])\n  @@index([reversalOfId])\n}\n\nmodel LedgerEntry {\n  id            String               @id @default(cuid())\n  transactionId String\n  accountId     String\n  direction     LedgerEntryDirection\n  /// Exact positive integer minor units (e.g. USD cents / micro-credits).\n  amountMinor   BigInt\n  currency      String\n  transaction   LedgerTransaction    @relation(fields: [transactionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  account       LedgerAccount        @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([transactionId])\n  @@index([accountId, currency])\n}\n\nmodel LedgerReservation {\n  id              String                  @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId  String\n  userId          String?\n  /// Idempotency key, unique per org: a replay returns the SAME reservation.\n  idempotencyKey  String\n  operation       String\n  status          LedgerReservationStatus @default(ACTIVE)\n  currency        String                  @default(\"usd\")\n  /// Authorized ceiling (hold, not a debit).\n  maxAmountMinor  BigInt\n  /// Actually settled at COMMIT (≤ maxAmountMinor).\n  committedMinor  BigInt?\n  rateCardVersion Int?\n  importJobId     String?\n  /// Correlated ledger transactions across the lifecycle.\n  reserveTxId     String?\n  settleTxId      String?\n  compensateTxId  String?\n  expiresAt       DateTime\n  committedAt     DateTime?\n  releasedAt      DateTime?\n  releaseReason   String?\n  metadata        Json?\n  createdAt       DateTime                @default(now())\n  updatedAt       DateTime                @updatedAt\n\n  @@unique([organizationId, idempotencyKey])\n  @@index([organizationId, status])\n  @@index([status, expiresAt])\n  @@index([importJobId])\n}\n\nmodel LedgerFxRate {\n  id           String    @id @default(cuid())\n  fromCurrency String\n  toCurrency   String\n  /// Exact rational rate = rateNum / rateDen (no float).\n  rateNum      BigInt\n  rateDen      BigInt\n  effectiveAt  DateTime\n  /// Exclusive upper bound this rate is valid for (cutoff).\n  cutoffAt     DateTime?\n  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())\n\n  @@index([fromCurrency, toCurrency, effectiveAt])\n}\n\nmodel LedgerReconciliationRun {\n  id               String                     @id @default(cuid())\n  organizationId   String?\n  /// GCP | STRIPE | LEDGER — the external source compared against the ledger.\n  source           String\n  status           LedgerReconciliationStatus\n  discrepancyCount Int                        @default(0)\n  discrepancies    Json?\n  runAt            DateTime                   @default(now())\n  metadata         Json?\n\n  @@index([source, runAt])\n}\n\n// BLOCKER #5 — honest preview readiness. The in-preview reporter script detects a\n// blank DOM / console error the server can never see and beacons it. Persisting\n// it (vs the old fire-and-forget log) lets `/ports` readiness be honest across\n// API replicas: a fresh blank/error beacon vetoes `ready` even when the port\n// probe passed. `status`: 'ok' | 'blank' | 'error'. One row per (workspace,port),\n// upserted; readiness only honours beacons newer than a short TTL.\nmodel PreviewReadinessBeacon {\n  id          String    @id @default(cuid())\n  workspaceId String\n  port        Int\n  status      String\n  detail      String?\n  reportedAt  DateTime  @default(now())\n  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([workspaceId, port])\n  @@index([workspaceId])\n}\n\n// BLOCKER #6 — timestamped workspace lifecycle machine. Append-only trail of\n// PENDING->STARTING->RUNNING->STOPPING->STOPPED/FAILED transitions so a workspace\n// that died can be reconstructed after the fact (vs Workspace.status, a single\n// overwritten value). `state` is a WorkspaceLifecycleState; transitions are\n// validated by assertWorkspaceLifecycleTransition before write.\nmodel WorkspaceLifecycleEvent {\n  id          String    @id @default(cuid())\n  workspaceId String\n  state       String\n  reason      String?\n  detail      Json?\n  at          DateTime  @default(now())\n  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([workspaceId, at])\n}\n\n// BLOCKER #6 — post-mortem snapshot captured when a workspace stops/fails: the\n// last-known ports, processes, Problems (beacons/diagnostics) and a tail of the\n// runtime logs, frozen at shutdown. Append-only (one per stop), so a support\n// operator can see WHY a preview was blank/dead after the pod is gone.\nmodel WorkspacePostMortem {\n  id          String    @id @default(cuid())\n  workspaceId String\n  reason      String\n  finalState  String\n  ports       Json?\n  processes   Json?\n  problems    Json?\n  logsTail    String?\n  capturedAt  DateTime  @default(now())\n  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([workspaceId, capturedAt])\n}\n\n// RR-1bd27929 — PER-PLAN ownership of account-purge freezes (§16.12). The old\n// model used GLOBAL id-lists, so two concurrent purges sharing an org/project could\n// not tell whose freeze was whose: releasing plan A lifted a freeze plan B still\n// needed. Now each active purge holds a PurgePlan (lease + ownerToken + version for\n// CAS reclaim) and each frozen resource is a PurgeFreeze row OWNED by exactly one\n// plan. A resource is frozen iff >= 1 PurgeFreeze row references it, so releasing\n// one plan only deletes ITS rows and never lifts a freeze another live plan owns.\n// The reconciler reclaims ONLY plans whose lease has expired, via CAS on version —\n// it never touches a live plan.\nmodel PurgePlan {\n  id             String        @id @default(cuid())\n  // RR-CODEX-12: at most ONE plan per subject — the per-user singleton that stops\n  // two workers running two physical purges of the same account.\n  userId         String        @unique\n  ownerToken     String\n  leaseExpiresAt DateTime\n  version        Int           @default(0)\n  // 'ACTIVE' while an owner holds it; 'RECLAIMING' once a reconciler CAS-claims an\n  // abandoned plan for cleanup (durable, so the old owner cannot continue).\n  status         String        @default(\"ACTIVE\")\n  createdAt      DateTime      @default(now())\n  freezes        PurgeFreeze[]\n\n  @@index([leaseExpiresAt])\n}\n\nmodel PurgeFreeze {\n  id           String    @id @default(cuid())\n  planId       String\n  resourceType String\n  resourceId   String\n  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())\n  plan         PurgePlan @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([resourceType, resourceId, planId])\n  @@index([resourceType, resourceId])\n  @@index([planId])\n}\n\n// RR-CODEX-14 (P6): the erasure PROOF written in the SAME transaction as the\n// tombstone. The purge-executor removes a user from the pending queue ONLY once a\n// PurgeReceipt exists — so a failed AdminAuditLog write can never leave a purged\n// account without a reconstructable proof. Unique per user (idempotent).\nmodel PurgeReceipt {\n  userId    String   @id\n  purgedAt  DateTime\n  proof     Json\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n}\n"
 }

Purely\n// additive: an `oldSlug` snapshot with an FK back to the project so rows cascade\n// away when the project is hard-deleted.\nmodel ProjectSlugRedirect {\n  id        String   @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId String\n  oldSlug   String\n  expiresAt DateTime\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  project   Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([projectId, oldSlug])\n  @@index([oldSlug])\n}\n\nmodel AgentMemory {\n  id                  String                @id @default(cuid())\n  userId              String\n  organizationId      String?\n  projectId           String?\n  sessionId           String?\n  scope               String\n  content             String\n  summary             String\n  embedding           Unsupported(\"vector\")\n  embeddingModel      String\n  embeddingDimensions Int                   @default(1536)\n  metadata            Json                  @default(\"{}\")\n  memoryType          String                @default(\"semantic\")\n  tags                String[]              @default([])\n  references          String[]              @default([])\n  importance          Float                 @default(0.5)\n  source              String\n  createdAt           DateTime              @default(now())\n  updatedAt           DateTime              @updatedAt\n  lastUsedAt          DateTime?\n  expiresAt           DateTime?\n  archivedAt          DateTime?\n  accessCount         Int                   @default(0)\n  user                User                  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  organization        Organization?         @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  project             Project?              @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([userId, scope, updatedAt])\n  @@index([memoryType, updatedAt])\n  @@index([organizationId, updatedAt])\n  @@index([projectId, updatedAt])\n  @@index([sessionId, updatedAt])\n}\n\nmodel AgentMemoryPreference {\n  id             String        @id @default(cuid())\n  userId         String\n  organizationId String?\n  projectId      String?\n  enabled        Boolean       @default(true)\n  createdAt      DateTime      @default(now())\n  updatedAt      DateTime      @updatedAt\n  user           User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  organization   Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  project        Project?      @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([userId, updatedAt])\n  @@index([organizationId, updatedAt])\n  @@index([projectId, updatedAt])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectIdeState {\n  projectId       String   @id\n  state           Json\n  version         Int      @default(1)\n  updatedByUserId String?\n  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt\n  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())\n  project         Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  updatedBy       User?    @relation(fields: [updatedByUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n}\n\n// Persists the AI-generated patch review queue across workbench reloads.\n// Terminal status proposals (accepted, rejected, reverted) are hard-deleted\n// because the audit trail lives in ProjectActivity; this table only holds\n// proposals the user still has to decide on. The id is the existing\n// \"artifactId:actionId\" composite the streaming runner already uses, so the\n// nanostore key and the row id line up 1:1.\nmodel AgentPatchProposal {\n  id              String   @id\n  projectId       String\n  artifactId      String\n  messageId       String\n  actionId        String\n  filePath        String\n  relativePath    String\n  originalContent String\n  proposedContent String\n  hunks           Json\n  status          String\n  error           String?\n  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt\n  project         Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([projectId, status])\n  @@index([projectId, updatedAt])\n}\n\n// Durable history of the agent's AST self-repair pipeline: each time a streamed\n// file fails validation and the agent retries (regenerates) it, the outcome is\n// recorded here so the IDE can show a review UI of auto-repairs/errors. Unlike\n// AgentPatchProposal (a transient working queue, hard-deleted on decision), this\n// is an append-only audit log. Additive + inert until the IDE records/reads it.\nmodel AgentRepairEvent {\n  id              String   @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId       String\n  messageId       String?\n  artifactId      String?\n  actionId        String?\n  relativePath    String\n  attempt         Int      @default(1)\n  // 'repaired' (validation passed after retry) | 'failed' (this attempt failed) |\n  // 'gave_up' (retry budget exhausted, original written best-effort)\n  outcome         String\n  validationError String?\n  repairError     String?\n  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())\n  project         Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([projectId, createdAt])\n}\n\n// Per-project enable/disable overrides for the builtin Skills catalog (Replit\n// parity). The catalog itself is a static, code-owned list (skills-catalog.ts);\n// this table only stores the sparse set of projects that toggled a skill away\n// from its default. Absent row => the skill is at its catalog default. skillId\n// is the catalog slug. Unique per (project, skill).\nmodel ProjectSkill {\n  id        String   @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId String\n  skillId   String\n  enabled   Boolean\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt\n  project   Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([projectId, skillId])\n  @@index([projectId])\n}\n\n// Installable GitHub-repo skills (F#27). A row records a PUBLIC GitHub skill repo\n// that a project or its workspace has installed, plus the instructions fetched\n// from the repo at install time. Polymorphic scope: scope='project' => scopeId is\n// a projectId; scope='workspace' => scopeId is a workspaceId. No FK (polymorphic),\n// so orphan cleanup is by the owning route. Layered ON TOP of the builtin catalog\n// (ProjectSkill) — that table is untouched. Unique per (scope, scopeId, ownerRepo).\nmodel InstalledSkill {\n  id                String   @id @default(cuid())\n  scope             String\n  scopeId           String\n  ownerRepo         String\n  name              String\n  description       String\n  instructions      String\n  homepageUrl       String?\n  enabled           Boolean  @default(true)\n  installedByUserId String?\n  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  // RPL-SK-001.3/.4 — provenance + security-audit + revoke state.\n  // origin: where the skill came from ('catalog' | 'github' | 'workspace-file' | 'builtin').\n  origin          String    @default(\"github\")\n  // sha256 of the audited disclosed surface (body + resources) — provenance integrity.\n  contentHash     String?\n  // Latest audit verdict: 'approved' | 'quarantined' | 'rejected'. A 'rejected' skill\n  // is never persisted enabled; a 'quarantined' one is disabled pending approval.\n  auditVerdict    String?\n  // JSON array of AuditFinding for the UI's audit panel.\n  auditFindings   String?\n  auditedAt       DateTime?\n  // Parsed interop-manifest fields (agentskills.io) when the skill is a real SKILL.md.\n  manifestName    String?\n  // JSON array of {path, kind, bytes} for progressive-disclosure L3 resources.\n  resourcesJson   String?\n  // Revoke is distinct from uninstall: the row stays for audit but is hard-disabled\n  // and cannot be re-enabled until re-installed.\n  revokedAt       DateTime?\n  revokedByUserId String?\n  revokeReason    String?\n\n  @@unique([scope, scopeId, ownerRepo])\n  @@index([scope, scopeId])\n  @@index([ownerRepo])\n}\n\n// Append-only audit journal for interoperable Agent Skills (RPL-SK-001.3). Every\n// consequential skill event — an install being approved/quarantined/REJECTED, a\n// manual approval, an enable/disable, a revoke, an uninstall — writes one immutable\n// row here so the security history of a project's skills is fully reconstructable.\n// No FK (polymorphic scope like InstalledSkill); never updated after insert.\nmodel SkillAuditEvent {\n  id           String   @id @default(cuid())\n  scope        String\n  scopeId      String\n  ownerRepo    String\n  // 'install-approved' | 'install-quarantined' | 'install-rejected' | 'approve'\n  // | 'revoke' | 'enable' | 'disable' | 'uninstall'\n  action       String\n  verdict      String?\n  findingsJson String?\n  contentHash  String?\n  actorUserId  String?\n  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())\n\n  @@index([scope, scopeId])\n  @@index([ownerRepo])\n  @@index([createdAt])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectEnvironment {\n  id        String   @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId String\n  name      String\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  project   Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([projectId, name])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectSecret {\n  id             String   @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId      String\n  key            String\n  valueHash      String\n  valueEncrypted String?\n  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt\n  project        Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([projectId, key])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectEnvVar {\n  id        String   @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId String\n  key       String\n  value     String\n  // Deployment scope this value applies to: development | preview | production.\n  // Defaults to \"production\" so every pre-scope row keeps its existing meaning.\n  scope     String   @default(\"production\")\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt\n  project   Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([projectId, key, scope])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectCollaborator {\n  id        String    @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId String\n  userId    String\n  roleKey   String\n  // When set, the grant is ignored after this instant. A time-limited share\n  // link writes its own expiry here so redeeming it no longer confers permanent\n  // access. Null = no expiry (direct invites).\n  expiresAt DateTime?\n  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())\n  project   Project   @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([projectId, userId])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectActivity {\n  id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId   String\n  actorUserId String?\n  action      String\n  metadata    Json?\n  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n  project     Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  actor       User?    @relation(fields: [actorUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n\n  @@index([projectId])\n  @@index([actorUserId])\n}\n\nmodel CollaborationPresence {\n  id             String   @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId      String\n  userId         String\n  sessionId      String\n  status         String   @default(\"online\")\n  filePath       String?\n  cursor         Json?\n  selection      Json?\n  mode           String   @default(\"editing\")\n  terminalAccess Boolean  @default(false)\n  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt\n  project        Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  user           User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([projectId, sessionId])\n  @@index([projectId, updatedAt])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel CollaborationComment {\n  id         String    @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId  String\n  userId     String\n  filePath   String?\n  line       Int?\n  selection  Json?\n  body       String\n  resolvedAt DateTime?\n  createdAt  DateTime  @default(now())\n  project    Project   @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  user       User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([projectId, createdAt])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectShareLink {\n  id              String    @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId       String\n  tokenHash       String    @unique\n  roleKey         String\n  expiresAt       DateTime\n  createdByUserId String?\n  revokedAt       DateTime?\n  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())\n  project         Project   @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  createdBy       User?     @relation(fields: [createdByUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n\n  @@index([projectId, expiresAt])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectTemplate {\n  id              String       @id @default(cuid())\n  sourceProjectId String\n  organizationId  String\n  name            String\n  description     String?\n  createdAt       DateTime     @default(now())\n  sourceProject   Project      @relation(\"ProjectTemplates\", fields: [sourceProjectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  organization    Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([organizationId])\n}\n\nmodel Workspace {\n  id               String                    @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId        String\n  name             String\n  status           WorkspaceStatus           @default(PENDING)\n  runtimeMode      String\n  // P2d dev/prod split: 'development' (the editable workspace) or 'production'\n  // (the checkout created when a deployment is published). Existing rows\n  // backfill to 'development'. Not unique — a project keeps multiple dev\n  // workspaces (primary + secondary agent-run checkouts); the prod checkout\n  // is the single workspace with environment='production'.\n  environment      String                    @default(\"development\")\n  // Filesystem path (relative to the project storage root) for this\n  // workspace's isolated git working tree. Allocated when the workspace\n  // is created so each branch / agent run can have its own checkout\n  // without colliding with other workspaces of the same project.\n  gitPath          String?\n  // Remote URL for this workspace's git working tree. Workspaces can point\n  // at different remotes (e.g. an agent run targets a personal fork while\n  // the primary workspace tracks the upstream project), so we store the\n  // remote here instead of falling back to Project.gitRepositoryUrl for\n  // every workspace. Nullable: a fresh workspace inherits the project-level\n  // remote until the user explicitly configures one.\n  gitRepositoryUrl String?\n  createdAt        DateTime                  @default(now())\n  updatedAt        DateTime                  @updatedAt\n  project          Project                   @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  sessions         WorkspaceSession[]\n  ports            WorkspacePort[]\n  snapshots        FileSnapshot[]\n  ideState         WorkspaceIdeState?\n  readinessBeacons PreviewReadinessBeacon[]\n  lifecycleEvents  WorkspaceLifecycleEvent[]\n  postMortems      WorkspacePostMortem[]\n\n  @@index([projectId])\n}\n\n// Workspace-scoped IDE state (open tabs, file manifest, scroll positions, …).\n// Mirrors ProjectIdeState 1:1 but keyed by workspace so each working tree can\n// keep its own editor cursor, file tree, and unsaved buffers. listFiles falls\n// back to the project-level state when a workspace has no entry yet, which\n// keeps backward compatibility with workspaces created before this table\n// existed.\nmodel WorkspaceIdeState {\n  workspaceId     String    @id\n  state           Json\n  version         Int       @default(1)\n  updatedByUserId String?\n  updatedAt       DateTime  @updatedAt\n  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())\n  workspace       Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n}\n\nmodel WorkspaceSession {\n  id          String          @id @default(cuid())\n  workspaceId String\n  userId      String?\n  status      WorkspaceStatus @default(STARTING)\n  startedAt   DateTime        @default(now())\n  stoppedAt   DateTime?\n  workspace   Workspace       @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([workspaceId])\n  // Presence-cleanup sweeps by userId (nullable); without this it full-scanned.\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel WorkspacePort {\n  id          String    @id @default(cuid())\n  workspaceId String\n  port        Int\n  url         String?\n  protocol    String    @default(\"http\")\n  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())\n  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([workspaceId, port])\n}\n\nmodel FileSnapshot {\n  id          String     @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId   String\n  workspaceId String?\n  path        String\n  contentHash String\n  sizeBytes   Int\n  metadata    Json?\n  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now())\n  project     Project    @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  workspace   Workspace? @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n\n  @@index([projectId, path])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectSnapshot {\n  id              String   @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId       String\n  label           String?\n  kind            String   @default(\"manual\")\n  manifest        Json\n  storageKey      String?\n  byteLength      Int?\n  createdByUserId String?\n  // Association used to pair a snapshot to the chat checkpoint that produced it.\n  // Populated for AI \"before-ai-change\" snapshots; NULL for manual/legacy rows.\n  // turnIndex is the assistant-turn ordinal within the conversation at the time\n  // the snapshot was taken (the first snapshot of a turn has the smallest\n  // createdAt). See migration 0046_snapshot_checkpoint_assoc.\n  conversationId  String?\n  turnIndex       Int?\n  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())\n  project         Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  createdBy       User?    @relation(fields: [createdByUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)\n\n  @@index([projectId])\n  @@index([createdByUserId])\n  @@index([conversationId, turnIndex])\n}\n\nmodel ProjectStorageObject {\n  id            String   @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId     String?\n  key           String   @unique\n  kind          String\n  contentBase64 String\n  byteLength    Int\n  contentHash   String\n  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())\n  project       Project? @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([projectId])\n  @@index([kind])\n  @@index([createdAt])\n}\n\nmodel Deployment {\n  id                 String                 @id @default(cuid())\n  projectId          String\n  workspaceId        String?\n  environmentId      String?\n  environmentName    String                 @default(\"preview\")\n  status             DeploymentStatus       @default(QUEUED)\n  provider           String\n  url                String?\n  previewUrl         String?\n  productionUrl      String?\n  framework          String?\n  buildCommand       String?\n  outputDirectory    String?\n  branch             String?\n  commitSha          String?\n  customDomain       String?\n  logs               Json                   @default(\"[]\")\n  metadata           Json                   @default(\"{}\")\n  rolledBackFromId   String?\n  // P2d dev/prod split: when a preview/staging deployment is published to\n  // production, the new production deployment links back to its source here.\n  parentDeploymentId String?\n  // Replit-parity deploy metering idempotency marker: set once the deployment is\n  // metered (mirrors WorkspaceRuntime.lastMeteredAt) so a re-reconcile never\n  // double-charges. Dormant/SHADOW until BILLING_CREDITS_ENABLED.
